_comment: Curated gallery metadata keyed by pack name. Merge order: defaults < this file < `dext pack list --json` ui block < the pack's own PACK.md ui-* keys. Packs absent here still list; they just are not curated. Personas: accountant | business | developer | everyone (empty = everyone).

receipts.title: Receipts & expenses
receipts.starter_prompt: Scan the receipts folder, sort every receipt into a category, and show me this month's spending as a chart

invoice.title: Invoices
invoice.starter_prompt: Create an invoice for my last job and show who still owes me money

reconcile.title: Bank reconciliation
reconcile.starter_prompt: Match my bank statement to the ledger and list anything that does not line up

cashflow.title: Cash-flow forecast
cashflow.starter_prompt: Project my cash for the next 13 weeks from the ledger and recurring bills; show it as a chart I can drag

taxprep.title: Tax prep
taxprep.starter_prompt: Estimate this quarter's tax from the ledger and build the package my accountant needs

followups.title: Follow-ups
followups.starter_prompt: Who owes me a reply, a payment or a document? Draft the reminders and I will approve each one

crew.title: Team
crew.starter_prompt: Plan a 3-worker crew to audit this folder for what is unfinished, risky or missing; show the plan only

mesh.title: Inbox
mesh.starter_prompt: Check my inbox for messages from other helpers and summarise anything that needs me

report.title: Report
report.starter_prompt: Summarise this workspace: what is here, what looks unfinished, top 3 risks — as an HTML report

autoresearch.title: Auto-research
autoresearch.starter_prompt: Pick one measurable thing in this workspace (a test suite's wall time, a script's runtime, a bundle size), try 3 variations, keep the best, show the numbers as a chart

packopt.title: Pack optimiser
packopt.starter_prompt: Show me what packopt would optimise in the report pack; do not apply changes

edge_browser.title: Browser (Edge)
edge_browser.starter_prompt: Open my current Edge tab and summarise the page

agent_browser.title: Headless browser
agent_browser.starter_prompt: Fetch the title and first heading of example.com

lightpanda.title: Lightpanda browser
lightpanda.starter_prompt: Fetch the title and first heading of example.com
